updates.new_evidence: Provider-neutral ordinary-8k, standard-32k and agentic-32k capability profiles are executable; unknown required capabilities yield CANNOT_CHECK and undersized models yield INCOMPATIBLE.
updates.remaining: Run a frozen cross-provider/local-model compatibility and scientific-task matrix; do not infer capability from marketing/model name.

updates.new_evidence: A non-editable no-dependency installation into an isolated target successfully executes python -m rakl; CLI E2E covers init, ingest, doctor, packet and status.
updates.remaining: Test built wheel/sdist in a genuinely fresh environment and add protected packaging entrypoint only under evaluator-aware re-freezing if desired.

updates.new_evidence: User-package vertical slice, canonical payload integrity, deterministic packets and diagnostics are executable.
updates.remaining: Durable execution, provider execution receipts, tokenizer calibration, evaluator dependency pinning, telemetry and real scientific benchmarks remain release blockers.

updates.new_requirement: Checkpoint/retry design must bind exact task-packet identity and completed side effects so a crash cannot duplicate experiments or mutate canonical evidence.

updates.problem: RAKL can compile provider-neutral task packets but lacks a governed adapter/run receipt that binds model/version, decoding settings, task packet, tool calls, raw output, cost/latency and retries.
updates.target: Freeze a deterministic fake-runner benchmark plus accessible real-model worlds before implementing provider adapters.
updates.falsifier: If external scripts with canonical task/output hashes give equal replay and audit quality at lower complexity, keep RAKL adapters thin rather than building a large orchestration layer.

updates.problem: Round-022 record token_cost is declared metadata; model-specific tokenization can differ and could invalidate a nominal context budget.
updates.target: Compare declared/conservative estimates with exact tokenizer counts for supported adapters and require headroom or CANNOT_CHECK when exact counting is unavailable.
updates.falsifier: If a simple conservative byte/character bound guarantees all reference profiles without material efficiency loss, avoid tokenizer-specific complexity.

updates.problem: Source SHA, installed distribution, benchmark packet, paper and generated result artifacts are not yet bound in one release identity graph.
updates.target: Create a release manifest with cryptographic digests for source, wheel/sdist, benchmark/reference packets, paper and result tables; verify it in a fresh environment.
updates.falsifier: If standard packaging provenance plus repository commit identity already gives all required reproducibility guarantees, deduplicate this into existing provenance/evaluator fibers.
